checklistSummary: Confirm hosted WebView vs any alternate architecture before installing Capacitor.
Confirm static export is not assumed because API routes and server boundaries are product-critical.
Verify auth callback, cookies, and possible deep link needs in app-display.
Verify microphone permission and MediaRecorder MIME behavior in iOS and Android WebView.
Verify protected audio playback and same-origin credentialed fetch inside WebView.
Verify upload size, MIME, ownership, and redaction boundaries remain intact.
Verify safe area, viewport, status bar, bottom navigation, and keyboard behavior.
Verify Privacy, Terms, Support, and Account deletion routes open inside app-display.
Verify final screenshot seven-screen set after app-display preflight.
Keep provider secrets server-side and leave provider readiness as separate gates.
Treat Android / Google Play checks as human-required later until device and console checks are available.
mainRisks: Current app is not static-export ready; API routes and server-side logic are required.
Supabase magic link callback and cookie session behavior may need native deep link or WebView session decisions.
iOS/Android WebView microphone and audio playback permissions may differ from Safari.
MediaRecorder MIME output may differ from iPhone Safari and affect upload/evaluation.
Safe area and status bar can change screenshot composition after Safari chrome disappears.
Provider calls and secrets must not move into native client code.
Android WebView / Google Play readiness remains unproven.
humanRequiredBeforeImplementation: Choose hosted WebView as first native architecture or explicitly approve another architecture.
Confirm Supabase Auth redirect/deep-link policy for native app flow.
Confirm intended iOS and Android devices / screenshot sizes for first native smoke.
Confirm native permission copy needs for microphone and audio playback.
Confirm legal/support/account deletion links must open in-app or external browser.
Confirm Android device availability and later Google Play checklist ownership.
Confirm no secret or env actual values need to be recorded in docs.
nextStep: Make a Capacitor introduction preflight decision and checklist for hosted WebView, auth/deep-link policy, permissions, and first non-destructive native smoke before any package install or project creation.
